title: FloodPay Rate Manual: Base Rates, Zone Factors, Minimum Premiums and Fees
content:
This rate manual sets the rating figures for FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines): the base rate for each tier, the zone factor for each FEMA flood zone, the minimum annual premium, the rounding of the annual premium, the sensor installation and monitoring fees, whether those fees bear surplus lines tax, and the payment plan offered.

## Section 1 — Tier rating figures

| Tier | Base rate (% of the payout limit, before the zone factor) | Minimum annual premium, before fees and taxes (USD) | Premium rounding increment (USD) | Installation fee (USD) | Annual monitoring fee (USD) | Surplus lines tax applies to the fees as well as premium | Payment plans offered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodPay Home 5K | 4.8 | 120 | 1 | 0 | 60 | Yes | Annual |
| FloodPay Home 10K | 4.5 | 220 | 1 | 0 | 60 | Yes | Annual |
| FloodPay Home 25K | 4.1 | 500 | 1 | 0 | 60 | Yes | Annual |
| FloodPay Business 50K | 3.9 | 950 | 1 | 150 | 120 | Yes | Annual |
| FloodPay Business 100K | 3.7 | 1800 | 1 | 150 | 120 | Yes | Annual |
| FloodPay Business 250K | 3.4 | 4250 | 1 | 350 | 240 | Yes | Annual |

Notes to Section 1:

- The **base rate** is the annual premium as a percent of the payout limit before the zone factor.
- The **minimum annual premium** is the lowest annual premium before fees and taxes.
- The **premium rounding increment** is the rounding of the annual premium; on every tier it is 1 US dollar.
- The **installation fee** is the fee for sensor installation, fully earned once installed. It is 0 on the three FloodPay Home tiers, 150 on FloodPay Business 50K and 100K, and 350 on FloodPay Business 250K.
- The **annual monitoring fee** is the annual sensor monitoring fee, fully earned at each term start: 60 on the Home tiers, 120 on FloodPay Business 50K and 100K, and 240 on FloodPay Business 250K.
- On every tier the surplus lines tax applies to the installation and monitoring fees as well as premium.
- The only payment plan offered on any tier is the Annual plan.

## Section 2 — Zone factor table

The zone factor is the rating factor for the FEMA flood zone of the insured location. The same table applies to every FloodPay tier.

| FEMA flood zone | Zone factor |
|---|---|
| X | 0.55 |
| B | 0.55 |
| C | 0.55 |
| D | 1.1 |
| A99 | 0.8 |
| AR | 0.8 |
| A | 1.0 |
| AE | 1.0 |
| AH | 1.0 |
| AO | 0.95 |
| V | 1.7 |
| VE | 1.7 |

Grouped by value: zones X, B and C carry 0.55; zones A99 and AR carry 0.8; zone AO carries 0.95; zones A, AE and AH carry 1.0; zone D carries 1.1; zones V and VE carry 1.7.
